title: Demonstrations at German airports against deportations

tea.why: People demonstrated against deportations, deportation detention, and the expansion of deportation infrastructure.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded an immediate halt to deportations and freedom of movement for all people.
tea.changed: Oct 24: Hundreds demonstrated at multiple German airports, including Leipzig, during a nationwide day of action.

summary: As part of a nationwide day of action, hundreds of people gathered for demonstrations at several airports across Germany, including Leipzig, Frankfurt am Main, Berlin Brandenburg, Cologne/Bonn, and Düsseldorf. The protests targeted deportations of rejected asylum seekers, deportation detention, and the expansion of related infrastructure, with specific opposition in Leipzig to charter deportations to Afghanistan. Organisers, including the We'll come united network and regional alliances, called for an immediate halt to deportations and the redirection of deportation funds toward refugee integration. According to authorities, deportation flights from Leipzig/Halle have primarily carried individuals who committed crimes.
demands: Freedom of movement for all people
Reallocation of funds from deportations to refugee integration
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: police estimated the number of protesters at around 400 in Leipzig

updates.text: Protesters gathered at airports across Germany, including Leipzig, for a nationwide day of action against deportations.
